content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (WARRANTY), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clauses reviewed:** §7.3 (product warranty + Warranty Period), §7.3 remedy paragraph (p0079) and its two exclusions, §7.2 (IP warranty), §7.4 (Y2K), the implied-warranty disclaimer fragment (p0084), §3.1 Acceptance Test refund, and §5 support/maintenance and Exhibit C — none of which supply a longer or separate performance warranty.
- **What passes fallback already:** conformance-to-Documentation warranty covering both the Software and the MarketSite.net Service (services ≥30 days satisfied by the 60-day period), correction/free replacement remedy, and refund of all prepaid fees where the breach cannot be corrected. The disclaimer is confined to implied warranties, so it does not swallow the express warranty.
- **What fails:** the Warranty Period is 60 days from the Effective Date and additionally capped at December 31, 1999 — below the 90-day software conformance floor.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** a single surgical replacement in §7.3 extending the period to ninety (90) days and deleting the December 31, 1999 outside date that would otherwise contradict the extension. No preferred-level extras (12-month period, workmanlike, compliance-with-laws) were volunteered.
